name: @pv/platform
description: Project Vacation platform: operating record, governance spine, workflow engine, knowledge layer. Consumed as the `pv` command line and the HTTP API it serves, not as a library — there is no src/index.ts and therefore no dist/index.js, so this package declares no main, types, or exports. Adding a library entry point means choosing a public API surface deliberately; declaring one that cannot be built is how `import "@pv/platform"` came to fail with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND on a build that succeeded.
